subject: polity
title: Making of the Constitution
description: Constituent Assembly, drafting process, committees, and timeline from 1946-1950

content.overview: The Constitution of India was drafted by the Constituent Assembly from 1946 to 1949, and came into force on 26 January 1950.
keyPoints: Constituent Assembly: 389 members (292 from provinces, 93 from princely states, 4 from chief commissioner provinces)
Drafting Committee: Chaired by Dr. B.R. Ambedkar, 7 members
Objective Resolution: Moved by Nehru on 13 December 1946, adopted on 22 January 1947

mnemonics.trick: A-N-B-R-K-M-S = Ambedkar, Naidu, Bora, Rau, Khaitan, Munshi, Sinha
mnemonics.explanation: Drafting Committee: Ambedkar (Chairman), N. Gopalaswami Ayyangar, Alladi Krishnaswamy Iyer, K.M. Munshi, Syed Mohammad Saadullah, N. Madhava Rau, T.T. Krishnamachari, B.L. Mitter
First meeting: Dec 1946, Adoption: Nov 1949, Enforcement: Jan 1950

quiz.question: Who chaired the Drafting Committee of the Constitution?
quiz.explanation: Dr. B.R. Ambedkar chaired the Drafting Committee

quiz.question: The Constitution was adopted on:
quiz.explanation: Constitution was adopted on 26 November 1949, came into force on 26 January 1950
